optionValues: Options are those changed from the template's defaults and in effect for the run: each test changes one options object step by step. {"absolute": day} is gnc-dmy2time64 of that day, local (here UTC) midnight. Symbols are written without the quote. The Trial Balance's Date of Report keeps its default, end-accounting-period, which reads 2024-03-15 23:59:59 under the pinned now; its Start of Adjusting/Closing default, start-accounting-period, reads 2024-03-15 00:00:00.
cellSelection: GnuCash reads text at HTML table positions with sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109): table 1 of the document; row N counts <tr> elements from 1 (negative from the end), null every row; column N counts <td> cells from 1, null every cell. The result is every text node in document order, so a blank cell gives nothing. A check with "count" expects the number of text nodes selected rather than their text.
